TypeOut is a keyboard that types the text you copied, one key at a time, at a human pace, instead of pasting it all at once.

Write and check your text wherever you like, copy it, switch to TypeOut in any app and tap Type clipboard. Watch it appear the way it would if you typed it yourself.

HOW IT TYPES
• Four speeds, from Relaxed (about 30 words a minute) to Rapid (about 75), and you can switch while it types
• Every run varies a little, with pauses after sentences and the odd glance back at the text
• Now and then it hits a nearby key, notices and fixes it. Never inside @names, #tags, links, emails or numbers, and the final text always matches what you copied
• Turn typos off any time

MADE FOR REAL USE
• Stop whenever you like. If you tap inside the text, switch text boxes or the screen locks, it pauses, and Continue picks up exactly where it stopped
• Where the return key sends or submits, line breaks are typed as spaces so nothing gets sent halfway
• Up to 5,000 characters at a time
• Tap ABC for ordinary letter keys when you want to type by hand
• A practice box in the app shows you how it works before you use it for real

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no tracking, no analytics, no ads
• Nothing you copy or type ever leaves your device. TypeOut's only network request is a tiny check for updates, which sends nothing about you
• The keyboard reads your clipboard only when you tap Type clipboard, and only to type it
• It saves just your speed and typo settings, on your device

ABOUT FULL ACCESS
Apple only lets a keyboard read the clipboard when Allow Full Access is on, and shows the same general warning for every keyboard that asks. TypeOut needs it for that one job. Without Full Access, TypeOut still works as an ordinary letter keyboard.

Your clipboard, right inside your keyboard.

Copy something on your Mac or any other computer — then paste it straight from the Syncer keyboard on your iPhone. No app-switching. No emailing links to yourself. Your clipboard simply follows you to every device.

WHY SYNCER

• Paste from your keyboard — the Syncer keyboard puts your synced clipboard inside any text field on your phone. Tap to insert; no jumping between apps.
• One clipboard, every device — your iPhone, iPad, Mac and the other computers you use all share a single clipboard.
• Encrypted end-to-end — every clip is sealed on your device before it leaves, and only your devices hold the keys. Our servers relay data they have no key to open.
• Searchable history — find anything you've copied. Keep it from 1 to 30 days (7 by default); it auto-expires after that.
• Passwords stay put — Syncer automatically skips items your device marks as sensitive, so passwords and secrets don't sync.
• Encrypted backups — protect your history with a PIN and restore it on a new device. We only ever hold ciphertext.
• Passwordless sign-in — a one-time email code, or Google / Apple. No password to remember.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Install Syncer on your devices.
2. Pair them in seconds by scanning a QR code.
3. Copy on one device, paste on any other — from the keyboard on your phone.

MADE FOR PEOPLE WHO COPY A LOT

Developers moving code and commands between a laptop and phone. Writers and students moving links, quotes, and notes. Anyone tired of shuttling text between devices by hand.

YOUR PRIVACY

We can't read your clipboard — the encryption makes it impossible. We don't sell data, show ads, or build a profile of what you copy. Analytics are strictly opt-in.

Syncer — one clipboard, every device.

Stop retyping the same messages. Save your go-to replies, addresses, payment details, and text snippets once, then insert them from the PasteKit keyboard in WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, LINE, email, and any other app that supports custom keyboards.

Made for people who send the same messages every day: online sellers answering buyers, freelancers sharing rates and details, and support teams handling common questions. No ads, and up to 25 clips free.

QUICK REPLIES FROM YOUR KEYBOARD
• Tap a text clip to insert it straight into the chat or text field.
• Tap an image clip to copy it, then paste it where you need it. iOS keyboards can't insert images directly.
• The keyboard opens straight to your clips and remembers your category, filter, layout, and scroll position.
• Search your saved clips right inside the keyboard.

ORGANIZE WITH CATEGORIES (FREE)
• Create colored categories such as Orders, Shipping, or Payments, and give each one an icon. New users can start with ready-made categories in one tap.
• Filter clips by category in the app and switch categories with tabs in the keyboard.
• Move clips between categories, pin the ones you use most, and arrange clips in your own order.
• Give clips optional titles so they're easy to spot.
• Sort each category by your own order, newest, oldest, or title. PasteKit remembers the choice for every category, and the keyboard follows it.

SAVE LINKS WITH A PREVIEW
• Share a link from Safari, the App Store, or any other app, and PasteKit adds the page title and a preview image automatically.
• Link titles are searchable and show in the keyboard, so the right link is always one tap away.

SAVE WITHOUT LEAVING YOUR CHAT
• Copy text or an image, then tap Save Clipboard in the PasteKit keyboard. No need to open the app.
• Optional: turn on "Auto-save when keyboard opens" and new text or images you copy are saved when the PasteKit keyboard appears. It's off by default.
• Share text, links, and images to PasteKit from the Share Sheet and choose a category.
• Use the Home Screen widget for quick actions.
Save Clipboard and auto-save require Allow Full Access.

YOUR CLIPS, YOUR CONTROL
• Clips stay on your device unless you turn on iCloud Backup & Sync (Pro).
• The PasteKit keyboard does not log or send what you type.
• Export all your clips to a JSON backup file or a CSV spreadsheet, and import them anytime, free.
• Deleted something by mistake? Recently Deleted keeps clips for 30 days so you can restore them.
• Lock PasteKit with Face ID or your passcode. The keyboard still works, so you can paste anywhere.
• Choose Light, Dark, or System appearance in Settings.

FREE AND PRO
• Free: up to 25 saved clips, plus categories, keyboard search, Save Clipboard, and export/import. No ads.
• PasteKit Pro: unlimited clips and iCloud Backup & Sync. Choose monthly, yearly, or lifetime.

QUICK SETUP
The built-in setup guide checks whether the keyboard is added and Full Access is on, explains Full Access in plain language, and gives you a field to try it out.
1. Open Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard, then choose PasteKit.
2. Tap PasteKit and turn on Allow Full Access so the keyboard can show your saved clips.
3. While typing, tap the globe key to switch to PasteKit.

Available in English, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), German, Bahasa Indonesia, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), and Vietnamese.
